text: うふふふふ　こんなに　たくさん　シールが　たまったぞ　だれかに　じまん　したいなー

structure.jp: こんなに　たくさん　シールが　たまったぞ
structure.en: I've piled up this many stickers!

structure.jp: だれかに　じまん　したいなー
structure.en: I sure want to show off to someone

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.span: じまん　したいなー
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb means 'want to do'; なー adds a dreamy 'I sure do'. じまん　したいなー = 'I sure want to brag'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is rough, boyish speech that adds force, here said to himself with pride. たまったぞ = 'they've piled up, all right!'.
